answer: One defence is Registered estate agent licence with property regulator attestation: a licence the regulator renews after compliance audits and exams, and the ocean of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the ledge of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The garden is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
